text: Based on the evidence, there is no detected tree-cover loss on the property after 2020. The data from 2021 to 2025 shows no events of 0.5 hectares or more. However, it's important to note that changes smaller than 0.5 hectares or at the edges might not be captured due to the resolution limits of the tools used. So, while no significant tree-cutting is detected, smaller-scale activities cannot be ruled out.
